data.gender_notes: Leela is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Leela refers to the divine play or performance of Gods, representing the creative expression of the universe. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the universe is a stage, and every being is an actor playing their role in this divine play. The name Leela carries the meaning “Play, Act, Performance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Leela usually hope their child will grow to embody play, act, performance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
